title: Slepian Discrete Prolate Spheroidal Sequence (DPSS) Mainlobe Concentration vs. Dirichlet-Sine Unit-Shift Duality
claims: For any finite window length P and target QFT mainlobe band |k| <= B, the principal eigenvector psi_DPSS* of the P x P Dirichlet-Toeplitz matrix K_B globally minimizes out-of-band QFT leakage L_leak(B) = 1 - <psi, K_B psi>.

At B = 1 (3-bin mainlobe), L_leak(1; psi_DPSS*) < L_leak(1; psi_sin*) < L_leak(1; psi_box), while gamma(1; psi_box) < gamma(1; psi_DPSS*) < gamma(1; psi_sin*) = cos(pi/(P+1)), with state fidelity |<psi_sin* | psi_DPSS*>|^2 > 0.998.
favorable_controls: P=16 and P=32 window comparisons at B=1
